- Refund requests: choose A (standard queue) based on accepted REQ-2414 and REQ-2418. C is invalid (REQ-2401, REQ-2406). Do not route refunds to C merely because they came through/from the regional office.
- Shipment requests: B was rejected for REQ-2417 despite an end-of-day urgency signal. No valid alternative is established; do not infer that invoice-routing rules apply.
- Do not select C solely because a request is from the east region; route by request type.
